svg.title: Which Analyzer for a Photo?
svg.desc: Decision tree for a photo. If it is text-heavy, like a receipt, use prebuilt-receipt, a document analyzer. If not, and you don't need your own fields, use prebuilt-imageSearch for a paragraph description. If you need your own fields, build a custom analyzer on prebuilt-image whose fields use classify or generate, for example ShelfStatus classified as Full, Low or Empty. Extract is documents only and never works for images. For a one-off question, ask a multimodal model (2.9), which gives no schema or confidence.
svg.text: Text-heavy photos go to a document analyzer; scenes use image analyzers with classify or generate.
